summary: CINDERELLA ECO GROUP AS (org. no. 998 619 408) is a private limited company (AS) based in Molde, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2012-07-16. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 22.240 (Produksjon av byggevarer av plast). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 2.7 m and net income was -NOK 895 600. Group (consolidated) revenue was NOK 265.4 m. CEO: Gunhild Sjøvik; board chair: Odd Kjell Sjøvik; auditor: CEDRA NORGE AS.
